question: Where is the nearest restaurant while traveling toward Jakes Rock Overlook and Mountain Bike Trail, Tidioute, PA from Main Street Art, Girard, PA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Main Street Art%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Girard%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) AS start_location, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Jakes Rock Overlook and Mountain Bike Trail%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Tidioute%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) AS end_location WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry :: geography, ST_MakeLine(start_location.geometry, end_location.geometry) :: geography, 500 -- Search within 500 meters of the straight-line path ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry :: geography, start_location.geometry :: geography) LIMIT 1;
